title: Penalties.
bodyText: Any caregiver who makes a false statement in the affidavit for caregiver consent required under section 302A-482, shall be subject to the penalties under part V of chapter 710.
bodyHtml: [§302A-483]  Penalties.  Any caregiver who makes a false statement in the affidavit for caregiver consent required under section 302A-482, shall be subject to the penalties under part V of chapter 710. [L 2003, c 99, pt of §1]
